newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's negotiator arrives at hostage site - radio.
newsitem.headline: Peru's negotiator arrives at hostage site - radio.

text.p: Peru's chief negotiator in the hostage crisis, Education Minister Domingo Palermo, arrived late on Monday at the Japanese ambassador's residence where Marxist guerrillas held 83 VIP hostages, local radio said.
Palermo arrived at 8.50 p.m. local time (0150 GMT).
Palermo's arrival came amid a surge of activity outside the residence.

It was his first visit to the building since Saturday when he spent more than three hours inside talking to the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebel leader Nestor Cerpa. That meeting led to the release of 20 hostages.
Prior to his arrival, police allowed journalists to move closer to the residence and applause and cheers were heard coming from inside.
